owen: Heads-up: onboarding sable-28k-int3 (quant3 hybrid) to staging. After repeatedly priming with an alternating short-system / long-user pattern up to ~29k tokens we see a reproducible single-index KV fingerprint bump and downstream token skew vs fp32 baseline. Repro & short logs below.

owen: repro (staging):
```
# run harness
python -m tests.long_kv_repro --model sable-28k-int3 --quant quant3 --prefill tests/data/alt_sys_long.txt --max-tokens 29000 --kv-inspect --kv-dump 50:30
```

owen: concise log excerpt:
```
kv_inspect: idx=28876 fp_before=0x4b9c2a fp_after_prefill=0x4b9c2b (bump)
gen: mismatch at pos 28877 expected="the" got="tha"
```

mai: did you try with --preserve-order? could be async prefetch merge ordering.\nowen: not yet, float32 run matches baseline so far. suspect quant round -> rotary interpolation at high exponent.

grace: paste model rotary config? also kv tiling params.\nowen: model cfg: rotary_base=10000.0, pos_scale=1.005, rotary_interp=linear. kv args: --kv-tile 256 --kv-stride 32 (default tiled).

hank: two quick experiments: dense indexing (--kv-stride 1 --kv-tile 65536) and alternate interp (--rotary_interp nearest). if dense fixes it, tile/stride collision likely. if nearest helps, interpolation amplification of quant noise is suspect.

ci-bot: CI: sable-28k-int3 canary started (canary-id: ci-20260312-21). Tests queued: long_kv_repro x3.

owen: running 3 variants now (preserve-order, dense-index, nearest-interp). adding a tiny dump script to print `idx,key_hash,fp_before,fp_after,ctx_snippet`. will attach trimmed diffs.

mai: also try toggling pos_scale to 1.0 and 0.998 to see sensitivity; small scale changes can push rotary phase over interpolation thresholds at large positions.
grace: and run with repeated short prefills that reach same absolute index (to separate absolute position vs content pattern).\nowen: good call. I'll post diffs in ~20m. adding a minimal single-file repro for CI as well. :coffee:
